**Exact model and firmware**
Use the product model, not its Bluetooth name or serial number. Write "unknown" if firmware is unavailable.

**Windows and Mantis versions / commit**

**Transport**
USB / Bluetooth Classic / BLE / unknown

**What was actually observed?**
Separate detected, paired, data-link connected, command response and physical drawing/cutting. Mantis currently cannot send jobs on any model. Do not run guessed commands to fill out this report.

**Reproduction steps and result**

**Sanitized diagnostic summary (optional)**
Review even redacted diagnostics before sharing. No raw traces, device addresses, serials, keys, account traffic or private project files. Describe the observation; never claim compatibility from a dropdown entry alone.
